err.STALE: This order changed while you were looking at it. It has been loaded again — check it and try once more.

err.BOOKED: A courier is booked: use “Cancel after booking”.
err.NOT_BOOKED: No courier is booked: use the ordinary cancel.
err.CANCEL_PENDING: A cancel is waiting for the courier's answer. Record that first.
err.NO_CANCEL_PENDING: No cancel is waiting for the courier.
err.CANCEL_REQUESTED: The customer asked to cancel. Answer that first.
err.NO_CANCEL_REQUEST: There is no cancel request to answer.
err.IN_REVIEW: A review is open (duplicate or risk). Decide it first.
err.ADVANCE_SHORT: The advance is not paid in full yet.
err.PAYMENT_DUE: Money would still be due on this order paid ahead. If his payment has not come in, wait for it (pending and failed payments have their own list) or cancel the order. If it is already confirmed, a delivery charge cannot be added here: the rider would collect money the records call paid. Ask the owner.
err.CHARGE_FIXED: The checkout already fixed this order's delivery charge; it is never changed here.
err.REASON_REQUIRED: Pick a reason from the list (and write the note “Other” needs).
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the form is not right. Check it and try again.
err.NOT_FOUND: This order (or note, or review) was not found.
err.NOT_MERGEABLE: These orders cannot go in one parcel (one is booked, finished or another customer's, or there is no other open order to join).
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: This was sent twice with different details. Close the box and try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: You don't have the permission for this.
err.UNAUTHENTICATED: You are signed out. Sign in again.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was changed — try again.
err.other: It did not work. Nothing was changed — try again.
err.NOTHING_CHANGED: Nothing changed — every field is as it was.
err.BAD_PHONE: That is not a Bangladeshi mobile number. Type 11 digits, like 01XXXXXXXXX.
err.NOT_SAME_PIECE: A line changes only to another size or colour of the same piece.
err.PRICE_DIFFERS: That size costs a different price now. An edit never changes a price — cancel and place a new order, or ask the owner.
err.OFFER_ON_ORDER: This piece is in a set or the order has an offer; taking it out would change a price. Cancel and place a new order, or ask the owner.
err.LAST_LINE: The last piece cannot be taken out. Cancel the order instead.
err.OUT_OF_STOCK: Not enough pieces of that size are free now.
err.RISK_OFF: The risk score is switched off (Orders → Risk rules).
err.NO_CHARGE: This order has no delivery charge to ask first. Pick another amount.
err.PARTIAL_UNSET: Set the percent of a part in Orders › Risk rules first.
err.NOTHING_DUE: Nothing is left to pay on this order.
err.NO_CHANNEL: Tick at least one way: SMS, WhatsApp or a call.
err.ALREADY_RESOLVED: Someone has resolved this check already. Reload to see it.
err.ORDER_REFUSED: The order cannot move now (for example a cancel is waiting). Sort that out first.
err.NOT_RETURNED: This parcel did not come back, so it takes no return reason.
err.ALREADY_LISTED: This number is on the blocklist already.
err.NOT_STALE: This parcel already matches the order, or it has left the shop. Read the page again.
err.COURIER_OFF: This courier account is switched off. Switch it on, or book with another courier.
err.NOT_SELLABLE: No piece for sale has this SKU. Check the SKU on the product's page.
err.COD_LIMIT: The amount due would pass the Cash on Delivery limit of this delivery area.
err.NOT_COD: Lines are added or taken out on Cash on Delivery orders only.
err.ADD_ON_LIMIT: This piece is already on the order as an added line.
err.ADD_ON_ONLY: Only a line added after the order was placed is taken out here. Use "Edit items & address" for the others.
err.NOT_RETRYABLE: This booking was closed or tried again already, or the order has a newer booking. Read the page again.
err.LOOKUP_AVAILABLE: This courier can be asked by our reference: press Try again instead.
err.DUPLICATE: Another parcel has this consignment id already. Check the number in the courier panel.
err.ADJUST_OFF: Price adjust is switched off in Rules.
err.ADJUST_TOO_MUCH: That is more than the customer still has to pay, or more than the wallet holds.
err.NOTHING_TO_ADJUST: There is nothing to take off.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PIN tries. Wait a while and try again.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set the PIN yet.
err.MERGE_OFF: Merging orders is switched off in Rules.
err.ADDRESS_DIFFERS: The addresses are different. Choose to go on with this order's address, or stop.

eff.cancelPay: A payment still waiting is closed (no money moves)
eff.refundReq: A refund request of {amount} goes to the owner — no money moves now
eff.refusedGoesOn: The parcel goes on; the order is marked “customer wants a change”
eff.noRisk: This never counts against the customer
eff.refuseKeep: The order goes on as it was; the request stays in the timeline
eff.holdStock: The pieces stay held for this order
eff.cabParcel: The parcel is not changed and not booked again
eff.cabPending: The order shows “Cancel pending courier” until you record the courier's answer

eff.reviewApprove: The review closes; the order can be confirmed
eff.reviewAsk: A call task is made for the team to ask the customer
eff.merge: The two orders go out in one parcel; prices, charges and payments stay as they are
eff.editLog: Each change is written on the timeline and the audit log: before → after, who, when, why
eff.editMoney: Prices, discounts, the delivery charge and COD never change; taking a piece out lowers the total and the amount to collect by that piece only
eff.editArea: The delivery area and its charge stay as the checkout stored them; if the new address is in another area, tell the owner
eff.editStock: A new size is held from stock and the old one goes back; the duplicate check runs again
eff.editPaid: A paid order: anything paid beyond the new total becomes a refund request for the owner — no money moves

eff.areaCall: The address call is closed and the address flags are cleared; an order the ERP already has goes again.
eff.phoneNext: The courier, the messages and the duplicate check use the new number from now on
eff.twoSizeAll: Every size goes in the parcel; nothing on the order changes.
eff.twoSizeOut: {sizes} is taken out: the total and the amount to collect fall by exactly its price, and its stock is freed.
eff.twoSizeOffer: A piece with an offer or a set price is not taken out by itself: the answer is kept and the order waits for you.
eff.twoSizeClose: The “2 sizes — check” flag and its call task close; the timeline keeps the answer.
eff.riskAssess: A new score with today's risk rules; the earlier one stays on the order's record
eff.riskInforms: Nothing is blocked, held or asked in advance
eff.reviewDecline: Cancelled with the reason "Declined after risk review" — never a block
eff.riskLevels: Your risk levels may then add a watch mark, a hold or a call; nothing is blocked or asked by itself
eff.blockList: {phone} goes on the blocklist with your reason, your name and the time
eff.blockNext: Only while the owner has the blocklist switched on, a new order from it is marked or held for a person
eff.blockNever: This order is not changed or cancelled, and the customer is not told
eff.bundleWith: The same person's other open orders to this address (now: {numbers}) go in the same parcel as this order
eff.bundleMoney: Each order keeps its own lines, prices, charges and payments
eff.bundleNever: Nothing is cancelled or held, and the customer is not told
eff.propBlock: The number goes on the blocklist with your reason and what we know (names, addresses, products with dates)
eff.propBlockNext: What its new orders get is the blocklist switch's choice (a mark, or a hold for a person)
eff.propNever: This order is not cancelled or held, and the customer is told nothing
eff.propDismiss: The number stays off the list; it is asked again only after a new rejection
eff.propHold: The order goes on hold with the proposed reason; your note is in the timeline
eff.propLetGo: The order goes on as it is; your note is in the timeline
eff.propNoCancel: Nothing is cancelled and the customer is told nothing
eff.priceDue: Never more than the customer still has to pay: {due}
eff.priceLimit: Your limit: {amount} or {percent}% of the price. Above it the request waits for the owner
eff.priceNoLimit: You have no limit on this
eff.priceLedger: A new line in the order's price ledger with your name and the reason; nothing is edited
eff.priceNoRefund: No money is refunded. The total and the amount at the door change
eff.priceApprove: The adjustment is applied to the order now. The owner's PIN is checked
eff.priceRefuse: The request is refused and the order stays as it is
eff.mergeMove: The lines you pick move onto this order at the price they were sold at

eff.mergeCharge: This order keeps its own delivery charge and address; the folded order's charge goes with it
eff.mergeAddress: Different address on {numbers}. Say go on to use this order's address

rr.offNote: Off — no band does anything until you switch this on. You can set the bands now and switch on later.

askOpt.codOff: No cash on delivery for this order

rr.suggestHelp: Fills in a suggestion: medium — watch, call and the delivery charge; high — watch, hold, call and the whole amount. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

rr.noBands: No risk bands are set yet.
rr.never: Never by itself: blocking anyone, changing COD, a price or a charge. Asking for money only with “Send the proposal by itself” on.

bd.h: One parcel for one person's orders
bd.d: When on, a new order looks for the same person's other open orders (the same identity or number) to the same address, placed within the hours you set and not yet with the courier. Each order keeps its lines, prices, charges and payments; nothing is cancelled or blocked.
bd.enabled: Look for orders to send together
bd.windowHours: Hours back an earlier order still joins
bd.windowHoursHelp: 1 to 168 hours. Empty until you set it: nothing happens until then.
bd.actionHelp: Propose: the order is marked and a person presses "One parcel". Group: they go in one parcel by themselves, with a note naming every order.
bd.readOnly: Only someone who may change the risk rules can change this.

bp.minRejectionsHelp: 1 to 50. Parcels refused at the door count (never your "our fault" reasons or a try-on). Empty until you set it: nothing is proposed until then.
bp.cancelCodes: Cancels that count as a rejection

gc.d: When on, a customer with at least the delivered orders you set, and no more refusals than you allow, is never held by the engine by itself: the duplicate check's automatic hold and a risk level's hold are skipped, and the order says “Good customer”. A review still opens for a person. What the engine stopped shows in Reports › Stopped by the engine.
gc.enabled: Never hold a good customer by itself
gc.minDelivered: Delivered orders that make a good customer
gc.minDeliveredHelp: 1 to 100, counted on the phone number. Empty until you set it: nobody counts as one until then.
gc.maxRefused: Refusals a good customer may have
gc.maxRefusedHelp: 0 to 20. Parcels refused at the door count (never your “our fault” reasons or a try-on).

td.d: When on, the moment a customer types a whole phone number at checkout, the shop looks for his order already on its way with the very piece in his bag (same product, colour and size). He sees the piece, that order's number and its tracking link, and chooses: take it out, or "No, I want another one". Nothing is cancelled or blocked. Each notice is kept with the campaign that brought him, below.
td.includeHelp: On its way: handed to the courier or in transit. Any open order: also ones not yet packed or sent.
td.windowDaysHelp: 1 to 120. An earlier order placed longer ago does not count.
td.byPhoneAlone: Also when only the number matches
td.byPhoneAloneHelp: Off: the notice shows only when the earlier order was placed from the same browser, device or account. On: a match by the number alone shows it too, but without the order's number or link, so a stranger learns nothing about someone else's order.
td.reportDaysHelp: 1 to 365. How many days the table below counts.
td.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.
td.repD: A campaign whose customers often order what is already on its way may be shown to them too often: cut its frequency cap.

td.sizeExchange: Another size: offer an exchange on arrival
td.sizeExchangeHelp: Off: only the very same piece shows the notice. On: the same product and colour in another size already on its way is a size worry — the notice offers to exchange that parcel when it arrives instead of sending a second one. Taking it out adds a line to the earlier order's timeline for the team.

pr.d: When on, the moment the phone number at checkout is whole, the shop asks the connected courier fraud checks in the background while the customer keeps typing, and keeps their answers for the checkout's own look and the order's score. A slow or failed check simply passes the customer. He never sees a score, a reason or a wait; nothing is blocked.
pr.budgetMsHelp: 200 to 10,000. A check slower than this is let go and the customer passes.
pr.cacheHoursHelp: 1 to 720. The same number is not asked again within this time; the checkout and the order's score read the kept answer.
pr.none: No courier fraud check is connected yet: connect Steadfast's, Pathao's or an aggregator's in Keys & connections (each is asked only after its Test passes). Until then the pattern below reads the shop's own records, the same device and the same person.
pr.connected: Asked at phone entry: {names}. Each answer counts on its own in the pattern below, and the highest failed share counts.
pr.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.

pt.d: Part of the risk score. Of the outcomes so far — taken at the door, refused (not our fault), cancelled with a counted reason — from this number, the same device and the same person under another number, the failed share is weighed by recency; each courier's own check counts on its own, and the highest share counts. Twenty orders with five to eight cancelled is not a pattern; five parcels all refused is. It only adds its weight to the score — what a score leads to is your levels, never a block.
pt.enabled: Count the pattern in the score
pt.weightHelp: 0 to 100 points added to the score when the pattern is seen.
pt.minParcelsHelp: 1 to 100. Fewer outcomes than this in one source is not a pattern yet.
pt.failPctHelp: 1 to 100. The pattern is seen when this share of the outcomes or more failed.
pt.halfLifeDaysHelp: 1 to 3,650. An outcome this old counts half, twice as old a quarter — so an old slip fades and a fresh run of refusals weighs most.
pt.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.

pc.d: When on, a prepaid order that nothing flagged (no duplicate, re-order, new identity, high or watch level) is confirmed the moment its money is in full, instead of waiting in To confirm › Prepaid for your tap. It only confirms: no money moves. An order with anything still to pay, a payment problem, a cancel request or an open review still waits for a person. Its timeline says it was confirmed by itself.
pc.enabled: Confirm a paid prepaid order nothing flagged by itself
pc.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.

cs.d: Six checks from a number's courier history become one score out of 10 (higher is better). At or above the green limit the order can confirm by itself (Auto-confirm), below the red limit it gets a red tag for a person, and in between it goes to the call list. Shown to staff only; customers never see it.
cs.enabled: Work out the courier score for new orders
cs.unknownNote: A check nobody could answer is Unknown: the score is never red because of it, the order goes to the call list.
cs.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change the risk rules can change this.
